description: This file defines a mutable builder class 'EffectedSubjectsBuilder' for constructing 'EffectedSubjects' objects. It provides a fluent API to add granted and revoked authorization subjects, ensuring consistency between these sets. It is part of the 'org.eclipse.ditto' project, specifically within the 'model.enforcers.tree' package.

classes.name: EffectedSubjectsBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for creating 'EffectedSubjects' instances with methods to add granted and revoked authorization subjects.

methods.name: EffectedSubjectsBuilder
methods.description: Constructor initializing the granted and revoked subjects sets.

methods.name: withGranted
methods.description: Adds a subject to the grantedSubjects set if it is not in revokedSubjects.

methods.name: withRevoked
methods.description: Adds a subject to revokedSubjects and removes it from grantedSubjects.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Creates an immutable 'EffectedSubjects' instance representing the current sets.
